title: EWShopping - Multi-Vendor E-Commerce Platform
description: Customer-facing multi-vendor online shopping platform. Features responsive mobile/desktop pages, product search, filters, sorting, category pages, cart and checkout, login/user session handling, dynamic product variant/stock pages, and optimized performance via lazy loading and efficient state handling.
bullets: Built and maintained an e-commerce website for customers.
Made responsive pages for mobile and desktop.
Added product search, filters, sorting, and category pages.
Added login and user session handling.
Used REST APIs to get and update product data.
Added product pages with price, variants, and stock details.
Improved app speed using lazy loading and better state handling.

title: EWShopping Courier Panel
description: End-to-end courier operations and fleet tracking management system. Implements parcel creation, rider assignment, tracking, and delivery status updates, pincode-to-area location mapping, and multi-tier role-based access control (Rider, Hub Admin, Staff).
bullets: Built features for courier creation, assignment, tracking, and delivery status.
Added pincode-to-area mapping for easy location selection.
Worked on Rider, Hub Admin, and Staff roles.
Added role-based access so users can access only allowed features.
Worked on courier tracking and status updates.
Improved backend data handling and fixed bugs.
Helped improve system stability and performance.
